entries.what: Jun opens Heron & Grind at 6:15, pulling shots for the Monday rush and pouring Wes Arnaud's 7 a.m. cortado.
entries.outcome: Smooth open, Wes left quarters as a tip.

entries.what: After clocking out at 2:30 he buys a case of wrappers at Ruiz Family Market in aisle 6 and fills up at the Ruel Road station.
entries.outcome: Wrappers stored in Tess's garage freezer.

entries.what: Evening at Tess's house, rolling a test batch of lumpia while OPM ballads play on the speaker.
entries.outcome: Tess complained her knee ached but kept rolling.

entries.what: Opening shift at the cafe; Jun walks Linh through pulling a cleaner shot between rushes.
entries.outcome: Linh's shots improved by the end of the morning.

entries.what: Lunch break spent texting Paolo about when to meet for shrimp and prep this week.
entries.outcome: Paolo said he'd confirm after his shift schedule.

entries.what: Evening he counts the cases of wrappers and the bank balance against his launch-cost target.
entries.outcome: Still under $1,800 so far.

entries.what: Tess is off Wednesdays, so Jun's morning is the cafe open and a quick coffee with her afterward at the house.
entries.outcome: Tess took a list of coworker lumpia orders for Saturday.

entries.what: Works the 6:15 opening shift, practicing a swan pour during the lull.
entries.outcome: Sam asked to swap an upcoming Saturday.

entries.what: Evening he tweaks the filling ratio for Saturday at the kitchen counter, tasting as he goes.
entries.outcome: Settled on a less onion-heavy mix.

entries.what: Opening shift at Heron & Grind, with Beatrice's corgi Ledger asleep in the back office.
entries.outcome: Quiet morning, no issues.

entries.what: Afternoon at the cafe he confirms Saturday counter plans, setting up the Saturday table and printing a small price card.
entries.outcome: Price card ready at $10 for a half dozen.

entries.what: Late evening he and Paolo trade texts about a prep time before the weekend; Paolo is vague because of his closing shifts.
entries.outcome: No firm time set.

entries.what: Early morning, Jun opens the cafe and hears from Paolo that he fronted the shrimp money, which Jun now owes him $260.
entries.outcome: Jun agreed to pay him back later.

entries.what: Before heading out he asks the assistant for a prep plan he can run solo in case Paolo is running late again.
entries.outcome: Got a timed prep plan for the Saturday batch.

entries.what: Evening he stops at Taquería Colima for al pastor tacos on the way home.
entries.outcome: Full and calmer.

entries.what: Calle Ortega Street Fair closes the street, and Jun arrives early to the cafe, which gets slammed with fair crowds. He sets up the Saturday table.
entries.outcome: Lumpia sold briskly, and Wes bought his two in quarters.

entries.what: Between rushes Jun wanders the fair stalls on his break, eyeing the vendor booths and chatting with Paolo, who finally showed up to help.
entries.outcome: Got ideas for banner and signage.

entries.what: Evening he brings leftover lumpia home to Tess for her verdict.
entries.outcome: Tess gave a few notes but ate three.

entries.what: Sunday morning pickup basketball at Delgado Park, then a late breakfast.
entries.outcome: Sore legs, good mood.

entries.what: Afternoon he tallies the week's lumpia sales and ingredient receipts into the notes app, putting off the shoebox.
entries.outcome: Totals roughly done.

entries.what: Tess is off Sundays, so they cook dinner together and she keeps the coworker order list on the fridge.
entries.outcome: Three new dozen orders added.
